stage1.impression: A night view through a shop window down a long, warm, hazy timber room. The haze, the pools of light and the low key are believable, but the faceless mannequin figures, the empty shelves holding a rainbow of glowing spheres, the beige strip at the end that reads as a lit soffit rather than glowing acrylic, and glass with no street reflection all say architectural render. As it stands it reads as a generic, well-lit bar visualisation, not a specific place a magazine would run: the one feature that makes it specific, the lantern, does not read as a freestanding box or a glowing band from this far back.

blocking_9: The lantern's amber fin band must read as the brightest glowing object in the room, saturated amber with its fins resolved (band lum_median >= 170, delta_e to #E8A040 < 10), instead of a pale beige strip lit from below
The lantern must read as a freestanding box: a dark gap or shadow at its sides and top, and its foot line visible, separating it from the room's walls
The shopfront glass must show a faint, believable reflection of the street (a streetlamp, a kerb, a passer-by's silhouette) across the upper and dark areas, or the 'through the glass' premise is lost
The figures must not read as faceless mannequins: more motion blur, set deeper in shadow, or dressed with coats and glasses in hand
The shop's shelves must read as dressed and lived-in (records, books, boxes, a few objects) rather than empty boards with a row of colour samples
The black panel at the right (1000-1200, 160-690) and the island's front (330-500, 540-690) must hold texture and edge detail instead of reading as flat dark planes
The window plinth's terrazzo must read at its real scale (fine chips, honed sheen) rather than coarse, noisy speckle at 1:1

defects.what: Lantern band reads as a flat pale beige soffit (median RGB 174/124/96, delta_e 18.9 to amber), with moire on the fins and a spot hotspot under it; it does not glow
Lantern face reads as a wall with a double door, not a freestanding box; no gap or shadow at its edges, foot line not visible
Four figures read as smooth faceless mannequins; motion blur is too weak to hide them
Shelves empty except a row of Cores; reads as a display, not a lived-in shop; shelf LED lines nearly clip and look like thin neon strokes
Shopfront glass shows almost no reflection of the street despite reflection 0.6; the window premise only reads from the mullion and plinth
Large flat near-black panel (median 22), no material or edge detail; dead area at the right third
Island front a flat dark slab (median 12.5), no steel sheen or edge highlight
Window plinth terrazzo chips coarse and noisy at 1:1, looks like denoised grain more than honed stone; lamp hotspots on it slightly blotchy
Saturated violet pendant competes with the Cores for colour; with the Core row and the window spheres the frame has many saturated colours and no single hero
Right plaster wall shows a faint repeated scallop of light from fixtures that reads as CG IES patterns

changes.problem: The lantern's acrylic band, the frame's reason to exist, reads as a pale lit soffit, not glowing amber fins.

evidence.measured: lum_median 132.5, RGB 174/124/96, delta_e 18.9 to #E8A040; fins show moire; a spot hotspot from below at x~570

change.setting: the lantern's band emission (and fin acrylic tint)
change.to: emission 1.5-2.5, 2200 K, fins in the amber tint (or Smoke over an amber source) so the light comes through the fins; aim the counter spot nearest the lantern away from the band

changes.expected: The band becomes the brightest and most saturated surface in the far room, an amber glow with fins resolved as fine light/dark slats, the hotspot gone.

changes.problem: The lantern does not read as a freestanding box; its face merges with the side walls.

evidence.measured: face median 72.8 with no dark separation at its edges; foot line not visible at the floor (y~545)

change.setting: the baffle's graze, the route and the fill
change.to: graze 0.9 W/m2 (2400 K) on the face only; route 0.03 and fill 0.06 so the gaps beside and above the box fall dark; the foot line 9.0 to 15.0 so it reads as a thin line on the terrazzo

changes.expected: A clear dark reveal at the box's sides and top, a thin bright line at its foot; the box stands in the room.

changes.problem: The shopfront glass shows no street reflection, so the frame reads as a render with a mullion rather than a photograph through glass.

evidence.measured: lum_median 11.9, no visible reflected structure; the dark right panel equally clean

change.setting: the street and the glass's reflection
change.from: glass reflection 0.6 with an unlit street
change.to: add a sodium/LED streetlamp and a lit facade opposite behind the camera (street light around 3000-4000 K, enough to show), keep reflection 0.6; optionally a soft fingerprint/dust layer

changes.expected: Faint, cooler reflections of a lamp and facade lines in the dark upper and right areas, readable but not obscuring the room.

changes.problem: The figures read as faceless mannequins and pull the image toward CG.

evidence.measured: smooth uniform grey-brown shapes with sharp heads; blur visible only on the left figure

change.to: 2-3 figures, shutter 1.5-2.0 with movement on the standing one; seat the others turned away in the banquette's shadow; give one a coat over the stool and a glass in hand

changes.expected: People read as life and motion, not as figures; nothing face-on and sharp.

changes.problem: The shop shelves are empty boards with a row of colour samples, which reads as a showroom.

evidence.measured: seen at 2x: bare oak shelves, one row of eight tinted Cores, LED lines near white

change.to: records face-out and spine-out, a few boxed Mantles, books and a plant across the shelves, Cores kept as placed; shelf lines 0.5

changes.expected: The left third reads as a record and object shop, warm and full; LED strokes soften to edge highlights.

changes.problem: Large dark planes (the right panel and the island's front) read as flat black with no material.

evidence.measured: lum_median 22, p95 80.7; island front [330,540,500,690] median 12.5 with p95 41

change.setting: the table spot and a new graze
change.to: table spot 8 W angled to catch the steel's top edge; a low 0.15 W/m2 2700 K graze along the right panel so its plaster or steel texture reads

changes.expected: The steel island gets an edge highlight and soft sheen; the right panel holds texture at median ~30.

changes.problem: The window plinth's terrazzo reads as coarse noisy speckle, not honed stone at real scale.

evidence.measured: at 2x: chips ~4-6 px across at the frame edge, grainy, blotchy lamp reflections

change.to: chips about half the size, a lower-contrast ground matched to the floor, roughness down slightly so the lamps leave soft honed reflections

changes.expected: The plinth reads as a honed stone ledge; reflections of the lamps soft and continuous.

changes.problem: The camera looks slightly upward from a standing passer-by's eye and spends the top sixth of the frame on black ceiling.

evidence.measured: lum_median 11.9 across the top 15% of the frame

change.to: look at [13.0, 4.2, 1.6] (level), lens 40 mm, so verticals stay true and the lantern sits larger in the frame

changes.expected: Less dead ceiling, the lantern band and box larger and central; verticals parallel.

out_of_scope.request: Fewer saturated tints in the frame (the Core row, the window Cores, the violet pendant) so one coloured object is the hero
out_of_scope.why: The Cores and Hemispheres in tints are fixed as placed; only their lighting can change

out_of_scope.request: Show the Tropos pair from the street
out_of_scope.why: The pair sits inside the lantern as placed; moving it or the lantern is an architecture change
